verdict.rationale: Godot is a game engine, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. Runtime probes found no official MCP: a GitHub search of the godotengine org returned 0 results, and the Asset Library has no MCP entries. Community servers such as Coding-Solo/godot-mcp are third-party, and the built-in GDScript LSP is a different capability, so neither earns credit.
